'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hello my brother! So how's it hanging? Not bored yet? Alright alright, just messing with you. I already figured you know how this one goes. You really can't fall off the influential guys' list, dude. At the very least, it's gonna plummet my rep. It's not gonna look good for me if my candidate falls off the list on the third task, so don't get too comfortable. So, like I said last time, something big's cooking. And you and I need to keep our fingers on the pulse. Here's a list of what we need to bring this time. Yeah, it's longer this time. Anyway, you're a smart guy, you'll figure it out.}}

==Requirements== 
* Must be level 35 to start this quest (30 in the [[Game_modes#PvE_and_PvE_Co-op_game_mode|PvE mode]]).
* Must have [[Prestige]] level 2

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 15 PMC operatives
* Eliminate 20 [[Raiders]]
* Survive and extract from [[The Lab]]
* Survive and extract from [[Streets of Tarkov]]
* Hand over 3 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] PMC figurines
* Hand over 3 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] Scav figurines
* Hand over 3 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] Boss figurines
* Hand over 3 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] Trader figurines

==Rewards==
* +11,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.1'''</font>
* 2,000,000 Roubles
** 2,100,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 2,300,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 2× [[Physical Bitcoin]]
{{quote|Excellent. Never letting me down, brother. My credibility is still there, and yours is on the rise. Perfect outcome, isn't it?}}
